done.why: I missed the sailor's boat by shouting instead of hailing, lost my sword in the lake, and found only blocked passages and a shadow land I could not map.

about: A Zork-style cave crawl. A dream tells you to seek an old silver-haired man when you are worthy. The map has a junction, a land of shadow, an ocean, a lake and an aqueduct view. A hooded double with a glowing sword guards the shadow land.

ending.what: None. I never found the old man.

moments.note: A glowing sword appeared in my hand when the hooded figure showed up.
The duel with the hooded figure was tense, and its death was well written.
Entering the lake made me drop everything, including the sword, with no warning.
The sailor's boat left after one shout and will not return. I did not know the right word to say.
The Land of Shadow rooms look alike and the directions loop, so I could not map them.

wished: A clue about what to say to the sailor.
A way to get the sword back from the lake.
A clearer map of the shadow land.

lines.line: It gazes up at you once, and you catch a brief glimpse of deep and sorrowful eyes.
The cramped way east runs a few yards and is choked with rock...Not today.
lines.why: It shows the blocked exits clearly, but there are many of them.

fun.why: The fight was good, but I hit many dead ends and one missed chance.

engagement.why: Interesting early, then stalled once the exits were blocked.

difficulty.why: The sailor can be missed for good, and I could not tell what to do next.

interestingness.why: The setting and the doppelganger fight are intriguing.
